summary: Executed backend + frontend regression for requested ProDelivery fixes. Backend passed 5/7 targeted checks (drivers metadata, clone preview, zone protection, driver create vehicle/email flow), with 2 critical auth/security failures. Frontend core admin/driver flows are functional: assign modal searchable, map markers + assign popup, restaurants protection dialog, program calendar/clone preview, dark mode toggle, and driver rank/email verification card.

critical.issue: Preflight returns `access-control-allow-origin: *` instead of explicit allowed origin while credentials are enabled.
No brute-force lockout/rate-limit after 5 failed logins; valid credentials still work immediately (expected 423/429).

integration_issues.issue: Console warnings show missing Dialog description (`aria-describedby`) in at least one driver dialog.

action_items: Fix CORS response for auth preflight to return explicit allowed origin (not `*`) when credentials are used.
Implement brute-force protection on login (failed-attempt counter + temporary lockout/rate limiting).
Address dialog accessibility warning by adding `DialogDescription` / `aria-describedby` where missing.
Validate auth playbook requirement: seed admin should update existing admin password changes instead of delete/recreate semantics.
critical_code_review_comments: `/app/backend/routers/auth.py` has no brute-force guard logic (no failed_attempts/lockout window).
Observed CORS mismatch at runtime vs expected explicit-origin policy for credentialed requests.
`/app/backend/routers/seed.py` resets collections; this does not satisfy a strict 'update existing admin if password changed' idempotent seed behavior.
`/app/frontend/src/pages/AdminDashboard.jsx` remains very large (>700 lines), hurting maintainability and test isolation.
seed_data_creation: Executed POST /api/seed during backend fixture setup.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Program tab and assign modal are working on current preview URL. Driver app login + schedule card + rank dialog + email verification card render correctly. Backend regression file for iteration 22 already added; rerun after auth/CORS fixes.
rca of the issue: RCA-1 (CORS): runtime preflight response exposes wildcard origin, likely ingress/middleware mismatch with backend CORS config. Repro: OPTIONS /api/auth/login with Origin=public app URL => ACAO='*'. Mitigation: enforce explicit origin reflection for allowlisted origins at the effective edge. RCA-2 (Brute-force): login endpoint directly validates bcrypt and returns tokens without tracking failed attempts. Repro: submit 5 invalid passwords then valid password; receives 200 token. Mitigation: add attempt counters + cooldown/lock + rate limiter per email/IP.
